title: Aligning LLMs for Multilingual Consistency in Enterprise Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance gap and internal reasoning consistency between high-resource (English) and mid/low-resource languages using exact match accuracy in a controlled multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) binary QA setup, as well as evaluating on multilingual benchmarks like MMMLU, MGSM, LAMBADA, and PAWS-X.
